# Security Policy

## Supported version

Only the current `main` branch and its production deployment are supported.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/basechildren/vrajmpatel.com/security/advisories/new) for suspected vulnerabilities. Please do not open a public issue for an undisclosed security problem.

Include the affected route or component, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation. Do not include secrets, personal data, or analytics credentials.

## Scope

Reports may cover:

- site source and generated client code;
- dependency, CI, and GitHub Pages deployment configuration;
- PostHog data-minimization or token-handling boundaries; and
